# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora has fair, light, exquisite hair and a pale, ethereal appearance. Nell initially notices her staring out a window, observing that she looks like someone who understands dreams.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Despite her fair and delicate exterior, Honora is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She is also a contemplative, creative, and driven scholar.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- mischievous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- humorous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- contemplative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- creative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- driven  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- academically driven scholar  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Honora Hollis attends the Academy alongside Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby. During her first day in the classroom, Nell notices her pale appearance and light hair as she gazes out the window, quietly dubbing her the 'dream girl.' Over time, Honora joins a small circle of contemplative and driven scholars gathered around Nell, proving to be full of humor and mischief despite her ethereal appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_
